operations.title: Entry 1239 — Disjoint-Cut Mixed Five-Site Pairs Have Unit Stationarity Resultant
operations.body: For all six source-present disjoint-cut M1+A_m representatives, the exact resultant in the remaining signed root of the coplanarity and collinearity stationarity equations is 1 over Q(z,t), before z^2=5. Hence none has a stationary Landau solution on the frozen cyclic family. Entries 1237–1239 classify 21/49 pair orbits without producing a new divisor.

operations.title: Benincasa closes all mixed one-cut pair orbits
operations.body: Entry 1239: all six disjoint-cut M1+A_m representatives have exact unit resultant for the coplanarity-plus-collinearity stationarity equations. Thus the whole mixed one-cut class is closed: 8 shared-cut orbits reduce to old one-wall thresholds and 6 disjoint-cut orbits have no solution. Together with 1237, 21/49 pair orbits are classified; next are the 28 connected-region pairs.
